releases.notes:
Fabric Loader compatibility update for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3: minimum loader is now **0.19.5+**. Minecraft 1.21.11 requires Loader 0.19.3+. Install Fabric API and the JAR matching your exact Minecraft version. Java 25+ is required for 26.2/26.3; Java 21+ for 1.21.11.

Released following maintainer in-game testing. This update lowers the loader requirement embedded in the JAR.

Credits: AdvancedCreativeTab by ate47 (source and editor workflow), HousingCreativeTab by BusterBrown1218 (feature inspiration), and PrismarineJS/minecraft-data. Licensed LGPL-3.0-only; see repository notices.

releases.notes:
Fabric client builds for Minecraft **1.21.11**, **26.2**, and **26.3**. Download only the JAR matching your exact Minecraft version and install Fabric API for that version.

- 1.21.11: Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 21+
- 26.2 / 26.3: Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Java 25+

All three builds pass 44 automated tests each and GitHub CI. **Release: the maintainer has completed in-game testing and confirmed that the builds work.** Server permissions and item validation still apply.

Includes the source archive, an optional ZIP containing all three builds, and SHA-256 checksums. ZIP files are not installed directly into the mods folder.

Credits: [AdvancedCreativeTab by ate47](https://github.com/ate47/AdvancedCreativeTab) (source and editor inspiration), [HousingCreativeTab by BusterBrown1218](https://github.com/BusterBrown1218/HousingCreativeTab) (feature inspiration; no restricted source redistributed). Licensed LGPL-3.0-only; see repository notices.
